text:
Here, orthodontic treatment is provided by a specialist orthodontist with a Ph.D. in orthodontics from Japan, and a member of both the Thai and international orthodontic associations, ensuring trustworthiness of the treatment.

The price is very affordable and accessible. For my case, the initial cost for braces was 599 baht, scaling was 550 baht, and each cavity was 550 baht. After that, I paid 1,000 baht per month for 30-36 months. Overall, it's great value for money, ideal for those who want orthodontic treatment from a true specialist at a comfortable price.

There are no hidden fees or extra charges; the prices are clearly stated upfront, making the decision easy and reassuring.

text:
I've always been afraid of the dentist, but after seeing Dr. Oat, everything changed.

Other places, doctors are harsh, heavy-handed, and when I have a problem, they're indifferent, like a tree stump. But here, the doctors are gentle, observant, and reassuring. I'm old, but this kind of care makes me feel so good about going to the dentist.

For anyone who used to be afraid of going to the dentist, this place will definitely change your mind. I wish every doctor in the world could be like Dr. Oat. Oh, and I really should compliment everyone on how kind and attentive they are to everyone, not just Dr. Oat. Thank you so much for making me, even though I'm almost 40, feel like dentistry isn't as brutal as it used to be, and the results are amazing.
